bagPolicy.summary: Clear plastic, vinyl or PVC bags up to 12 × 6 × 12 inches, or a nonclear clutch up to 6 × 9 inches, are allowed after inspection.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: Parking is sold separately from the concert ticket: $20 plus tax online in advance or $25 on event day for a general pass. Lots usually open two hours before the scheduled gate time; use US-301 or MLK Boulevard for general parking.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue visitor guide does not identify a specific rideshare pickup and drop-off point.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Food and beverages are sold inside, with selections that change by event. Outside food and drinks are prohibited except factory-sealed water bottles.
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Accessible parking uses the Orient Road entrance and requires a visible state-issued plate or placard plus a purchased venue parking pass. Spaces are first come first served.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The show-day box office opens at 3 p.m. Check the event confirmation for the ticket delivery or collection method.
